model: torchcrepe full (CREPE, Kim et al. 2018), weights torchcrepe/assets/full.pth

preprocessing.audio: vocals stem, mono 16 kHz float32 (the Demucs vocals stem resampled 44100 -> 16000)
preprocessing.frame_i: padded[320*i : 320*i + 1024] (centred at sample 320*i of the unpadded signal)
preprocessing.standardise: frame = (frame - mean(frame)) / max(1e-10, std(frame)) with UNBIASED std (ddof=1, divide by 1023)
preprocessing.batch: any batch size; song.py uses 256; results are batch-independent

postprocessing.decoder: viterbi (torchcrepe.decode.viterbi): obs[t] = softmax over the 360 masked bins of probs[t] (plain softmax of the sigmoid values, NOT logits); transition[i,j] = max(12 - |i-j|, 0) / row sum (i.e. /144); p_init uniform 1/360; log domain with +tiny (float32 tiny = 1.1755e-38) on obs, transition and init: value[0] = log(obs[0]+tiny) + log(1/360+tiny); value[t][j] = log(obs[t][j]+tiny) + max_k(value[t-1][k] + log(trans[k][j]+tiny)), ptr[t][j] = argmax_k (first max wins); backtrack from argmax(value[T-1]). Transitions are only non-zero within |i-j| < 12, so the max over k can be banded (23 wide).
postprocessing.cents: cents = 20*bin + 1997.3794084376191 (+ dither: torchcrepe adds triangular noise in [-20, 20] cents, unseeded; the client may omit it or add its own; tokens see <= 0.014 difference)
postprocessing.periodicity: periodicity[t] = probs[t][bin[t]] (the sigmoid value at the decoded bin, pre-softmax)
postprocessing.median: periodicity = median filter, window 3, reflect padding: out[t] = median(x[t-1], x[t], x[t+1]) with x[-1] = x[1], x[T] = x[T-2] (torchcrepe.filter.median; NaN-aware, no NaNs occur here)
postprocessing.fit: both arrays truncated/edge-padded to T = ceil(N16/320) frames (song.py fit)
postprocessing.voicing: vocal_active = (periodicity > 0.5) & (stem_rms[3] > 0.02); vocal_pitch = midi where vocal_active else NaN; stored float16
postprocessing.syllables: vocal_syllables (analysis-spec.md section 7): onset_strength envelope of the vocals stem (librosa defaults, hop 320), onset_detect peak_pick pre_max 1, post_max 1, pre_avg 5, post_avg 6, wait 1, delta 0.07 on the [0,1]-normalised envelope; keep peak p iff vocal_active[max(0,p-2):p+3].any(); strength = z-score of the raw envelope at p

wasm_note: fp32: dynamic int8 tested and rejected (accuracy below the fp16 graph)
